title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers
description: Fast and Furious Spy RacersA government agency recruits teen driver Tony Toretto and his thrill-seeking friends to infiltrate a criminal street racing circuit as undercover spies.

episodes.title: S4-E5The Ocelot King vs. El Mariposa

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 1x1
episodes_data.description: Tony is pumped when his legendary cousin Dom recruits him and his friends for an exciting mission: to infiltrate a secret street racing circuit.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 1x2
episodes_data.description: After Tony rocks it against Layla in a thrilling race through LA, SH1FT3R boss Shashi invites Tony's crew to join his group by pulling a job for him.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 1x3
episodes_data.description: Tony takes on all the SH1FT3R racers in a remote ghost town. But Tony's real mission isn’t to win -- it's to track what scheme Shashi's up to.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 1x4
episodes_data.description: While Tony works with Layla and Shashi to steal codes from a Russian businessman, Ms. Nowhere sends the others to snoop around Shashi's mansion.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 1x5
episodes_data.description: The crew enters a SH1FT3R race up a privately owned mountain. Can they find out what Shashi wants at the summit without blowing their cover?

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 1x6
episodes_data.description: Ms. Nowhere tells the crew that the mission is over, but Tony isn't ready to give up. He's too much of a Toretto to back off now.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 1x7
episodes_data.description: When the crew takes over an amazing spy plane, they meet Shashi in the desert to exchange precious cargo. Will they also learn Shashi's master plan?

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 1x8
episodes_data.description: It's up to Tony and his crew to save the world when Shashi sets up a showdown with evil billionaire Cleve Kelso on the Las Vegas strip.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 2x1
episodes_data.description: When the Spy Racers make a big bust in LA, they learn about a secret operation in Brazil and plead with Ms. Nowhere to let them go undercover.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 2x2
episodes_data.description: After arriving in Brazil, the crew gets their ride stuck in quicksand. But Tony's determined to get them out of trouble without Ms. Nowhere’s help.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 2x3
episodes_data.description: The Spy Racers explore Rio hoping to find the gang that captured Layla, but soon have to question if she’s on their side or has turned against them.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 2x4
episodes_data.description: After Frostee discovers that the secret formula is explosive, Tony and Echo go into overdrive to find a tanker full of it before it blows up Rio.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 2x5
episodes_data.description: An old friend helps the team figure out who’s behind the evil plan, then makes a shocking discovery after a hair-raising race in the streets.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 2x6
episodes_data.description: On a dangerous mission to recover the hauler, Echo has to think quick on her feet to avoid capture by a surprising enemy.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 2x7
episodes_data.description: As a plan comes together to unleash the formula on an unsuspecting public, the Spy Racers scramble to stop it.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 2x8
episodes_data.description: With an angry mob on their tail, the team must pull out all the stops to recover the spy plane and save the world from a chilling reign of terror.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 3x1
episodes_data.description: Tony can't figure out why Echo was picked over him for spy school. Ms. Nowhere and Gary pursue a trio of familiar villains in Africa.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 3x2
episodes_data.description: Echo leads the Spy Racers to the Sahara to find Cleve Kelso, but when they're all captured, Layla and Tony must win a dune buggy race for their freedom.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 3x3
episodes_data.description: The Spy Racers help a village with a water well that's run dry. Meanwhile, Ms. Nowhere and Gary try to make contact from the middle of... nowhere.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 3x4
episodes_data.description: With Kelso's lair in their sights, the team gets dragged into an epic dune buggy chase through the desert. Layla clashes with an old enemy.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 3x5
episodes_data.description: A hurricane in the Sahara? The team finds shelter with a group of Bedouins to escape a storm's wrath. Ms. Nowhere and Gary make an unexpected discovery.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 3x6
episodes_data.description: As Kelso closes in on his evil goals, the Spy Racers face a tough decision in the remote desert. Will they follow their heads or their hearts?

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 3x7
episodes_data.description: Minus one key member, the team makes a final push to infiltrate Kelso's base to stop him from unleashing his diabolical plan.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 3x8
episodes_data.description: The showdown in the Sahara comes to a fiery end when a swirling megastorm threatens to take out everything in its path — including the Spy Racers.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 4x1
episodes_data.description: Ms. Nowhere is rewarded with a party at headquarters when a worldwide chase leads to a big capture. But the celebration may be short-lived.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 4x2
episodes_data.description: Frostee works to bring Ms. Nowhere and the Spy Racers to safety. And now that the agency had turned on all of them, it's time to go rogue.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 4x3
episodes_data.description: On the run and facing a shortage of money, the crew turns to what they do best — racing! — to earn enough cash to get them to Mexico City.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 4x4
episodes_data.description: Ms. Nowhere and the Spy Racers crash a masquerade ball in Mexico City when stolen artifacts clue them in about who might have framed them.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 4x5
episodes_data.description: As Ms. Nowhere and Echo confront Palindrome, Cisco tracks down Tuco in the wrestling ring, and Layla tells Frostee she feels unwanted on the team.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 4x6
episodes_data.description: Trapped inside a hauler, the whole crew needs help as the authorities close in on them — and their hopes may rest on the newest member of the family.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 4x7
episodes_data.description: The Spy Racers are once again racing against the clock, this time to stop Mexico City from being destroyed by Moray's fiery volcano machine!

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 4x8
episodes_data.description: Deep in lava-filled tunnels under the city, the Spy Racers make one last stand against Moray to stop his evil plan once and for all.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 5x1
episodes_data.description: The Spy Racers get caught up in playing a new virtual reality video game. But fun turns into frustration when Tony doesn't act like a good teammate.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 5x2
episodes_data.description: With one of their own in danger at the hands of their old enemy Sudarikov, the Spy Racers take to the sky for a daring aerial rescue.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 5x3
episodes_data.description: From high in the sky to deep in the water! With a barrage of torpedoes on their tail, can the Spy Racers engineer an undersea escape?

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 5x4
episodes_data.description: Stranded on an island in the South Pacific, the team plots its next move while trying to help Tony overcome his mysterious inability to drive.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 5x5
episodes_data.description: Ms. Nowhere believes Shashi holds the information the team needs, so she agrees to free him for a day — even though the others doubt he can be trusted.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 5x6
episodes_data.description: Layla, Tony and Shashi attempt to infiltrate Sudarikov’s island base. Elsewhere, the others struggle to rein in their out-of-control spy plane.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 5x7
episodes_data.description: The team finally gets into Sudarikov's underwater compound and must pull out all the stops to get the base shut down before disaster strikes.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 5x8
episodes_data.description: To stop the virus from taking over the world, the Spy Racers will have to come together as a family to battle the most familiar foe they’ve ever faced.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 6x1
episodes_data.description: The stressed-out Spy Racers hope to blow off some steam — and blow up some stuff — on the agency’s "Incineration Day." But their fun will be short-lived.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 6x2
episodes_data.description: The team follows the person behind the Incineration Day incident all the way to the Alps, but is their prime suspect a mastermind or a pawn?

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 6x3
episodes_data.description: When Rafaela busts out of prison and starts causing trouble in Berlin, the team aims to shut her down to find out if she's behind the stolen spy tech.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 6x4
episodes_data.description: Frostee becomes convinced that someone very close to him is behind the spy tech theft, and it leads to another high-speed chase on the Autobahn!

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 6x5
episodes_data.description: A member of the team has been kidnapped and taken to the Arctic, but Tony and Echo don’t see eye to eye on the best plan to get their friend back safely.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 6x6
episodes_data.description: Racing against the clock, the Spy Racers must disarm a weapon designed to melt the polar ice caps and leave much of the world underwater.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 6x7
episodes_data.description: The Spy Racers are getting comfortable with their return to civilian life at home, but Tony is obsessed with the notion that Dann is still out there.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 6x8
episodes_data.description: With the team unofficially back together, they hope to bring Nowhere and Palindrome back into the fold. Echo and Tony pay a visit to Matsuo.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 6x9
episodes_data.description: As Dann works to collect more of the devices she needs to execute her plan, the team drops in on a familiar face who becomes an unexpected ally.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 6x10
episodes_data.description: The Spy Racers call in some old friends — and foes — to battle with Dann at an oil refinery and try to take her down to save LA.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 6x11
episodes_data.description: When everyone gathers to attend a big movie premiere, Tony thinks about his life after the Spy Racers. But the team's last mission isn't over yet.

episodes_data.title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers 6x12
episodes_data.description: As the ground rumbles beneath LA, the Spy Racer family comes together one last time to end Dann's reign and make their hometown safe again.
